sourceBindings.role: immutable proposal/source record superseded by accepted v2 design
accepted human-first design bound for RM-55 through RM-67 contracts
required roles/scenarios/records and blocked custody state

reviewerAgreementWhenApplicable.notApplicableRule: not-applicable is a blocked evidence state, never a passing zero

denominators.eligibleReviewedItems: Every case/item with a valid SourceVersion, review receipt, final disposition, and no integrity failure; confirmed, edited, rejected, abstained, and missing-output records remain included.
denominators.acceptanceRates: Use eligibleReviewedItems; rejection, abstention, and missing output are denominator records and never successes.
denominators.reviewTime: Use completed records with valid start, stop, and non-overlapping pause segments; missing or invalid timing is a scored integrity failure, not a dropped record.
denominators.editBurden: Count semantic edits per reviewed item; report reviewed-note aggregation separately and never replace the primary item denominator.
denominators.agreement: Use independently double-reviewed records before adjudication; adjudication is a separate recorded outcome and cannot overwrite either raw decision.
denominators.unsupportedFinalizedAssertions: Denominator is every finalized assertion, including rejected/abstained candidates that must not finalize; missing denominator records block the gate.
denominators.invalidRecords: Malformed, duplicate, tampered, stale, or digest-unbound records fail closed and block acceptance; they are not silently excluded.

timingPolicy.start: Server receipt when the selected item has loaded verified source/evidence and the reviewer can take an explicit action.
timingPolicy.stop: Server receipt when the explicit final review decision is durably acknowledged.
timingPolicy.pause: Only explicit pause, navigation away, hidden/disabled review state, or an idle interval of at least 60 seconds; every pause has a non-negative bounded interval and pauses are excluded from active time.
timingPolicy.manualBaseline: Use the same start/stop/pause policy, same reviewers, matched cases, blank manual-entry workflow, and counterbalanced order.
timingPolicy.invalidTiming: Negative, overlapping, missing, or non-monotonic intervals block the gate.

missingAndDisagreementPolicy.missingOutput: Scored failure and denominator record; never silently dropped.
missingAndDisagreementPolicy.rejection: Valid final disposition but not an acceptance success; retain reason and provenance.
missingAndDisagreementPolicy.abstention: Valid only when evidence is insufficient/ambiguous/unsupported under the allowlist; scored separately and not an acceptance success.
missingAndDisagreementPolicy.disagreement: Compute pre-adjudication agreement on independent decisions; a qualified adjudicator records the rule and outcome without mutating either decision.
missingAndDisagreementPolicy.invalidOrTampered: Block the gate and preserve the receipt/event as an integrity failure; do not impute a class or timing.

requiredJourneys: Distinguish requests, commitments, risks and blockers
Handle ambiguity, hostile text and isolation boundaries
studyDesign.manualBaseline: Same reviewers review the same matched material without Projecta proposals, in counterbalanced order, with source/evidence access and equivalent final-disposition controls.
studyDesign.heldOutRequirement: External custody, frozen candidate, and blinded protocol must be established before RM-68 execution; this contract does not inspect or authorize held-out data.

statisticalReporting.confidenceInterval: Report a preregistered 95% bootstrap or exact interval appropriate to each metric.
statisticalReporting.slicePolicy: Report every declared journey, language, semantic, ambiguity, threat, origin, and split slice; empty slices are not-applicable and block any claim requiring them.

nonGoals: No observed human results or human-quality claim
No held-out inspection or custody claim
No provider calls, reruns, validation access, Stage B, selection, promotion, or release
No ontology, runtime, materialization, inference, or production enablement
F1 and other model metrics are diagnostic only and cannot substitute for correction-burden evidence
No RM-68 preregistration or study execution in this artifact
